visualCharacteristics.purpose: Tariff comparison table with label column, tariff columns, coloured header and group sub-headings
visualCharacteristics.layout: Coloured header row, zebra rows, optional sticky header under the site header

contentPattern.structure: one row per table row: label cell then tariff cells (text or :check:/:close: icon paragraphs); a single-cell H3 row starts a group

usage: Tariff comparisons on program pages, often inside an accordion panel
reuseGuidance: Reuse product-table for new pages with the same content pattern; add an option class rather than a new block for colour or layout differences.
